The Cold Sato is Only Sweet to Me
synopsis: Satou-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer. Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat! Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

synopsis: For the love of all things otaku--anime, video games, figures, you name it! Power-pedaling Sakamichi Onoda has long been conquering the steepest slopes and regularly making the ninety-kilometer round-trip to Akihabara on a mommy bike!! But when his bike commute to his new high school lands him in a confrontation with the serious first-year road racer Imaizumi, Onoda has a major showdown on his hands! synonyms: The strongest sword saint is reincarnated as a beautiful maid and becomes unrivaled with a broom
synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)

Akari joins the group as an odd job and gradually increases hia own value by demonstrating hia cooking skills. Each leader of the mercenary group is a quirky character, but Akari connects with them through his cooking. By improving the mercenary group's food situation and occasionally helping with inventions, Akari is gradually recognized by his fellow members of the mercenary group. However, Akari does not yet know that he himself will become a hero.
